events.name: Goodbye GTA 5
events.description: On a pier at sunset, three men in a game-style scene say goodbye to you: a game case as a parting gift, a handshake, the car keys, a teary close-up, then you drive off in a pink sports car down the beach road.

events.name: James Bond Reveal
events.description: A spy-movie teaser in total darkness: a hand on a pistol catches the light first, then the face rises out of the shadow and stares down the lens.

events.name: Winter Pet Bath
events.description: Your pet stands up in striped boxer shorts in a chilly bathroom, scoops water with a plastic dipper and dodges every splash, then hugs itself, hurries to the bedroom and squeezes under a pile of quilts.
